# Carpenter

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## Become a Carpenter

Tom built Roger's ship and paid for it with his freedom. His apprentices kept building anyway.

Choose Carpenter as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Carpenter

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Carpenter XP +300

<a id="q-4e8806e93bb068d9"></a>

## Apprentice Carpenter

A carpenter's first boat leaks. Their second one leaks less.

Reach Carpenter level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Carpenter](carpenter.md#q-305f923ef173deab)

**Tasks**

- Reach Carpenter level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Carpenter XP +800

<a id="q-5d660c415964a24a"></a>

## Journeyman Carpenter

Galley-La's docks in Water 7 build the finest hulls on the sea. Bring them yours.

Reach Carpenter level 25, Build a Reinforced Boat and land on a shipwrights' town in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Carpenter](carpenter.md#q-4e8806e93bb068d9)

**Tasks**

- Reach Carpenter level 25
- Build a Reinforced Boat
- Land on a shipwrights' town in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Carpenter XP +3,000

<a id="q-1ffd9e2647f7f8f3"></a>

## Expert Carpenter

The Thousand Sunny was built from Adam wood bought on the black market. You will need a Lumberjack friend for the planks.

Reach Carpenter level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Carpenter](carpenter.md#q-5d660c415964a24a)

**Tasks**

- Reach Carpenter level 50
- Build a boat of Adam Wood

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Carpenter XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-53f9ae0bb4668c35"></a>

## Master Carpenter

Water 7 calls its best shipwright a foreman of Galley-La.

Reach Carpenter level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Carpenter](carpenter.md#q-1ffd9e2647f7f8f3)

**Tasks**

- Reach Carpenter level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
